ddl:
CREATE TABLE User (
    Areas_of_Interest VARCHAR(255),
    Date_of_Birth DATETIME,
    Email VARCHAR(255),
    Gender BOOL,
    Number_of_Followers INTEGER,
    Password VARCHAR(255),
    User_Account VARCHAR(255),
    User_Creation_Time DATETIME,
    User_Description VARCHAR(255),
    User_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    User_Name VARCHAR(255)
);

CREATE TABLE Podcast (
    Cover_Image_Path VARCHAR(255),
    Creation_Time DATETIME,
    Last_Update_Time DATETIME,
    Number_of_Favorites INTEGER,
    Number_of_Likes INTEGER,
    Number_of_Visits INTEGER,
    Podcast_File_Path VARCHAR(255),
    Podcast_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Podcast_Name VARCHAR(255),
    Publisher_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Type VARCHAR(255),
    FOREIGN KEY (Publisher_ID) REFERENCES User(User_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE Playlist (
    Creation_Time DATETIME,
    Last_Update_Time DATETIME,
    Number_of_Favorites INTEGER,
    Number_of_Likes INTEGER,
    Number_of_Visits INTEGER,
    Playlist_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Playlist_Name VARCHAR(255),
    Playlist_Path VARCHAR(255),
    User_ID_who_created_the_playlist INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (User_ID_who_created_the_playlist) REFERENCES User(User_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE User_Publishes_Podcast (
    Podcast_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    User_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (User_ID, Podcast_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Podcast_ID) REFERENCES Podcast(Podcast_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (User_ID) REFERENCES User(User_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE User_Creates_Playlist (
    Playlist_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    User_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (User_ID, Playlist_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Playlist_ID) REFERENCES Playlist(Playlist_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (User_ID) REFERENCES User(User_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE Playlist_Contains_Podcasts (
    Playlist_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Podcast_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (Podcast_ID, Playlist_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Playlist_ID) REFERENCES Playlist(Playlist_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Podcast_ID) REFERENCES Podcast(Podcast_ID)
);
gold_question: DevFlix is ​​an innovative audio content sharing platform that aims to provide users with a comprehensive service that integrates podcast publishing, playlist management and audio collection. User information includes username, user account, email, password, user description, gender, interest area, number of followers, number of people following, and user creation time. Podcast information includes publisher, podcast file path, type, podcast name, cover image path, number of visits, number of likes, creation time, number of favorites, and last update time. Playlist information includes the user who created the playlist, the user who created the playlist, playlist name, number of visits, number of likes, creation time, number of favorites, creation time, and last update time. DevFlix allows users to register accounts, publish and manage their own podcasts, interact with other users and create playlists. The platform also provides a collection function, allowing users to save content of interest and access it at any time. In addition, DevFlix also has detailed statistics and analysis functions to track the visit data and user interaction of each podcast and playlist.

The database schema named 'rschema_0087' consists of six tables: User, Podcast, Playlist, User_Publishes_Podcast, User_Creates_Playlist, and Playlist_Contains_Podcasts.
The User table represents a user of the platform and contains information about the user such as areas of interest, date of birth, email, gender, number of followers, password, user account, user creation time, user description, user id, and user name.
The Podcast table contains information about podcasts such as cover image path, creation time, last update time, number of favorites, number of likes, number of visits, podcast file path, podcast id, podcast name, publisher id, and type. The Publisher_ID field in the Podcast table is a foreign key referencing the User_ID in the User table.
The Playlist table contains information about playlists such as creation time, last update time, number of favorites, number of likes, number of visits, playlist id, playlist name, playlist path, and the user id who created the playlist. The User_ID_who_created_the_playlist field in the Playlist table is a foreign key referencing the User_ID in the User table.
The User_Publishes_Podcast table represents the relationship between users and podcasts. It contains the podcast id and user id, and both are foreign keys referencing the Podcast_ID and User_ID in their respective tables.
The User_Creates_Playlist table represents the relationship between users and playlists. It contains the playlist id and user id, and both are foreign keys referencing the Playlist_ID and User_ID in their respective tables.
Finally, the Playlist_Contains_Podcasts table represents the relationship between playlists and podcasts. It contains the podcast id and playlist id, and both are foreign keys referencing the Podcast_ID and Playlist_ID in their respective tables. This schema ensures referential integrity by maintaining the relationships between tables.
